candidate.title: AI Terms Explained: Multi-hop Reasoning
candidate.description:
In this episode of AI Explained, we'll explore what multi-hop reasoning is and how it's enabling AI models to answer complex questions by connecting multiple pieces of information from various sources.

For additional definitions visit our AI Term Glossary: https://www.moveworks.com/insights/ai-terms-glossary
